name: Redis Operations
description: Check Redis service, connectivity, memory, and persistence, and do not flush or reset it unless the user explicitly allows that.

permissionsRequired.reason: Run redis-cli INFO and service status on a configured server alias.
Run the same checks when Redis is local.

validation.rule: Service, connectivity, memory, or persistence was inspected before a change, and no FLUSHALL, FLUSHDB, or CONFIG RESETSTAT ran without explicit authority.
